senses.gloss: f. (= רָוָה) moist, saturated with liquid, opp. עבה thick and pulpy.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 10:3:3">Y. Pes. X, 37ᵈ</cite> top <he>צריכה שתהא ר׳ וכ׳</he> (not <he>צבריה</he>) it (the <cite ref="H01630"><he>חֲרוֹסֶת</he></cite>) must be saturated (with wine), which means that it is to remind of blood.—V. <cite ref="T00302"><he>רוֹבֶה</he> II</cite>.
